name: Police Phase D1 - Incident State and Dock Intercept
description: Tests police.status responses and dock-intercept enforcement. Crime event generation is exercised through player commands in the Phase B incident suite; this suite seeds incident state through SQL fixtures.

tests.name: Setup: Create test player for D1 testing
Rig: Remove stale D1 test-only ports

data.sql: DELETE FROM ports WHERE name IN ('V3 QA D1 Lawful Port', 'V3 QA D1 Lawless Port');

tests.name: Rig: Ensure a port exists in a lawful non-Fed cluster sector

data.sql: WITH chosen AS (SELECT c.clusters_id, cs.sector_id, c.law_severity FROM cluster_sectors cs JOIN clusters c ON c.clusters_id = cs.cluster_id WHERE c.role = 'RANDOM' AND c.law_severity > 0 AND cs.sector_id > 10 ORDER BY c.clusters_id, cs.sector_id LIMIT 1), ensured_port AS (INSERT INTO ports (name, sector_id, type, porttype_id, petty_cash) SELECT 'V3 QA D1 Lawful Port', chosen.sector_id, 1, pt.porttype_id, 100000 FROM chosen CROSS JOIN porttypes pt WHERE pt.code = 'CLASS0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ports p WHERE p.sector_id = chosen.sector_id AND p.is_active) RETURNING sector_id) SELECT chosen.sector_id, chosen.clusters_id, chosen.law_severity FROM chosen;

tests.name: Rig: Find a port in the lawful cluster

data.sql: SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE sector_id = @{lawful_sector} LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Rig: Position test player in lawful sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = @{lawful_sector} WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester';

tests.name: Rig: Position test player's ship in lawful sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = @{lawful_sector} WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester');

tests.name: Baseline: police.status should show no incidents in lawful cluster initially
Rig D1-C1: Initialize lawful-cluster incident row

data.sql: INSERT INTO cluster_player_status (cluster_id, player_id, suspicion, wanted_level, banned) VALUES (@{lawful_cluster_id}, (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester'), 0, 0, false) ON CONFLICT(cluster_id, player_id) DO NOTHING;

tests.name: Rig D1-C1: Seed lawful-cluster suspicion for status response

data.sql: INSERT INTO cluster_player_status (cluster_id, player_id, suspicion, wanted_level, banned) VALUES (@{lawful_cluster_id}, (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester'), 1, 0, false) ON CONFLICT (cluster_id, player_id) DO UPDATE SET suspicion = 1, wanted_level = 0, banned = false;

tests.name: Verify D1-C1: police.status shows suspicion=1
Rig D1-C2: Seed elevated suspicion and wanted level

data.sql: UPDATE cluster_player_status SET suspicion = 3, wanted_level = 1 WHERE cluster_id = @{lawful_cluster_id} AND player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester');

tests.name: Verify D1-C2: police.status shows suspicion=3 (1+2), should be wanted_level=1
Rig D1-C3: Seed wanted level two for dock-intercept response

data.sql: UPDATE cluster_player_status SET suspicion = 5, wanted_level = 2 WHERE cluster_id = @{lawful_cluster_id} AND player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester');

tests.name: Verify D1-C3: police.status shows wanted_level=2 (enforcement threshold)
Test D1-D1: Dock intercept returns enforcement details when wanted=2
Rig: Ensure a port exists in the lawless ORION cluster

data.sql: WITH chosen AS (SELECT c.clusters_id, cs.sector_id, c.law_severity FROM cluster_sectors cs JOIN clusters c ON c.clusters_id = cs.cluster_id WHERE c.role = 'ORION' AND c.law_severity = 0 ORDER BY cs.sector_id LIMIT 1), ensured_port AS (INSERT INTO ports (name, sector_id, type, porttype_id, petty_cash) SELECT 'V3 QA D1 Lawless Port', chosen.sector_id, 1, pt.porttype_id, 100000 FROM chosen CROSS JOIN porttypes pt WHERE pt.code = 'CLASS0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ports p WHERE p.sector_id = chosen.sector_id AND p.is_active) RETURNING sector_id) SELECT chosen.sector_id, chosen.clusters_id, chosen.law_severity FROM chosen;

tests.name: Rig: Position test player in lawless sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = @{lawless_sector} WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester';

tests.name: Rig: Position test player's ship in lawless sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = @{lawless_sector} WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester');

tests.name: Test D1-L1: Lawless contraband should NOT create cluster_player_status

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cluster_player_status WHERE cluster_id = @{lawless_cluster_id} AND player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester');

tests.name: Rig D1-L1: Confirm the lawless cluster has no incident row

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cluster_player_status WHERE cluster_id = @{lawless_cluster_id} AND player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester');

tests.name: Verify D1-L1: cluster_player_status row was NOT created (count after)

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cluster_player_status WHERE cluster_id = @{lawless_cluster_id} AND player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester');

tests.name: Assert D1-L1: Lawless invariant proven (before count == after count == 0)

data.sql: SELECT @{lawless_status_before} = @{lawless_status_after} AND @{lawless_status_before} = 0 AS invariant_holds;

tests.name: Rig D1-L2: Confirm the lawless cluster still has no incident row

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cluster_player_status WHERE cluster_id = @{lawless_cluster_id} AND player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester');

tests.name: Verify D1-L2: cluster_player_status row still absent

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cluster_player_status WHERE cluster_id = @{lawless_cluster_id} AND player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'd1_crime_tester');

tests.name: Rig: Find port in lawless cluster

data.sql: SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE sector_id = @{lawless_sector} LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Test D1-L3: Docking is allowed in a lawless cluster
Test D1-S1: police.status in lawless cluster should return OK but no jurisdiction
Cleanup: remove D1 test-only ports

data.sql: DELETE FROM ports WHERE name IN ('V3 QA D1 Lawful Port', 'V3 QA D1 Lawless Port');
